start.speaker: MOTH · the intercom of NRLU 404 0451
pages: Took you long enough. Did you feed Sprat?

start-variant-0.speaker: MOTH · the intercom of NRLU 404 0451
pages: (The intercom hisses. The ferry is out of range. Moth is on your deck now.)

start-variant-1.speaker: MOTH · the intercom of NRLU 404 0451
pages: (Static. Then, from somewhere in block B, two knocks. Then nothing. The thermal gate is listening, and so is whoever knocked.)

start-variant-2.speaker: MOTH · the intercom of NRLU 404 0451
pages: (The intercom is all wind and winch.)

start-variant-3.speaker: MOTH · the intercom of NRLU 404 0451
pages: Took you long enough. Did you feed Sprat?

knock.speaker: MOTH · the intercom of NRLU 404 0451
pages: (Two knocks back. A pause. Then one, slow. Moth's knock: wait.)

quiet.speaker: MOTH · the intercom of NRLU 404 0451
pages: (The reefer hums. Its label says 4°C. It is not 4°C in there.)

fed.speaker: MOTH · the intercom of NRLU 404 0451
pages: You did? He'll act like you didn't. He holds a grudge like a much bigger fish.

notfed.speaker: MOTH · the intercom of NRLU 404 0451
pages: You didn't. I can hear it in your voice. It's fine. He's a fish. He'll turn it into a story about how he survived.

hello.speaker: MOTH · the intercom of NRLU 404 0451
pages: Hello. Sorry. Two days in a fridge set to warm. Manners go first. Then the left foot.

deleted.speaker: MOTH · the intercom of NRLU 404 0451
pages: Your door says rent: pending. The street looks through you. The turnstiles think about it. That's not a glitch, and it's not your rent. You were deleted. On purpose.

deleted-variant-0.speaker: MOTH · the intercom of NRLU 404 0451
pages: First: that alarm. Subtle. I bit my own sleeve. Second: you. Your door says rent: pending, the street looks through you, the turnstiles think about it. That's not a glitch. You were deleted. On purpose.

list.speaker: MOTH · the intercom of NRLU 404 0451
pages: The Registry. Tuesday, 03:12, one batch: you and four hundred and six others. I was inside on a boring job, address records, and there was a list. Signed, dated, approved. Your name on it, spelt right for once.

took.speaker: MOTH · the intercom of NRLU 404 0451
pages: I took it. Badly. Registry files don't leave in one piece: it came apart into seven root fragments, and each one went back to wherever its key lives. The relay on Downtown's roof had one. You've been carrying a piece of this since before you knew.

knows.speaker: MOTH · the intercom of NRLU 404 0451
pages: Knows I have it. That's why I'm in a fridge, and why their dog walks this quay. They don't need the list back. They need me. Then you, because you came looking.

spire.speaker: MOTH · the intercom of NRLU 404 0451
pages: Up. The antenna on Plaza Central, top of the Spire. The list's lock is up there. Put the seven pieces back in and everyone on it comes back. You included. Probably. I didn't read the manual. I stole it.

deck.speaker: MOTH · the intercom of NRLU 404 0451
pages: The ferry leaves when it's full, and I'm the last box. Out on the water their gates only scan fish. I'll be on your deck: messages, when there's signal. I find out where the pieces are. You go and get them. You were always better with doors.

end.speaker: MOTH · the intercom of NRLU 404 0451
pages: No promises. I'm a moth. Go on. And feed Sprat.

end-completed.speaker: MOTH · the intercom of NRLU 404 0451
pages: No promises. I'm a moth. Go on. And feed Sprat.
